title: Khaprail Tiles Colors: Natural Red, Glazed Green and More
excerpt: Which colours do khaprail tiles come in? Natural red and glazed green, how finish changes the look over time and how to choose from real samples.
meta_title: Khaprail Tiles Colors: Natural Red and Glazed Green
meta_description: See which khaprail tile colours Pak Clay lists, how natural red and glazed green age, and how to choose from a free sample sent on WhatsApp.
answer_box: Pak Clay lists khaprail tiles in natural red clay and in glazed green. Natural red is colour-through and blends with brick and stone, while glazed tiles have a fired-on coating that wipes clean. Look at free samples in your own light before choosing.
ai_summary: Khaprail tile colours at Pak Clay currently fall into two families: natural red clay and glazed green. Finish affects ageing and upkeep, and screens misreport colour, so samples matter. Pak Clay, in Lahore since 1982, sends a free sample on WhatsApp and gives a dated written quote.
author: Pak Clay Team

faqs.question: What colours do khaprail tiles come in?
faqs.answer: Pak Clay lists natural red and glazed green khaprail profiles on its website. For another colour, ask on WhatsApp and get any confirmation in writing with a sample.

faqs.question: Do glazed khaprail tiles cost more than natural red?
faqs.answer: They may be quoted differently because glazing is an extra manufacturing step. Price also depends on profile, quantity, season and transport, so ask for a dated written quote.

faqs.question: Is natural red better than glazed green for a roof?
faqs.answer: Neither is better in every case. Natural red is colour-through and blends with brick and plaster, while glazed green wipes clean and stands out. Compare samples outdoors.

faqs.question: Do khaprail tile colours fade?
faqs.answer: Natural clay tends to soften gently with sun and rain, and glazed surfaces hold their look longer, but no finish is permanent. We publish no fade-rate figures.

faqs.question: How can I see khaprail colours before ordering?
faqs.answer: Message +92 300 4617715 on WhatsApp with your city and profile. We offer a free sample so you can check colour and finish in your own light.
